lesson: When the row variable is a complete lattice variable, sum it first: the theta coefficient then meets the Gauss sum of its own row symbol and collapses to Moebius times a ray character, so the row mean square is a mean value of 1/L over the twist family of the target. (E-K) is therefore target-dependent and of zero-free type, not an operator-norm statement. A sharpness theorem for a sieve has to be read against the exact row symbol and angular factor before it is used as a refutation; the cubic-row control reproduces the Dunn-Radziwill growth (exponent 0.31 to 0.32 against 1/3), the probe rows show none. Under family GRH deleting the K-loss is a theorem for M >= 1+l, so the false input of the no-floor free-geometry region is among the signal exponent at lx < l, H0 at h > 1, and G.
